IGCS Connector - licence
========================

Two third-party components are bundled here. Neither is part of Rockstar
Editor+; both are the work of Frans Bouma (Otis_Inf) and are included because
Rockstar Editor+ uses the connector to read the GPU frame buffer, which an ASI
cannot do on its own.

  IgcsConnector.addon64                     MIT
  reshade-shaders\Shaders\IgcsDof.fx        BSD 2-clause

Project: https://github.com/FransBouma/IgcsConnector
Author:  Frans Bouma, https://opm.fransbouma.com
IgcsDof.fx additional contributions by Pascal Gilcher (Marty McFly),
https://www.martysmods.com

The canonical licence texts live in that repository; the notices reproduced
below are included to satisfy each licence's attribution requirement.
